# Ved Prashnavali

> Free devotional tools in English and Hindi: the Ram Shalaka, Hanuman, Sai Baba, Shiv, Ganesh, Durga and Khatu Shyam prashnavalis (traditional question-and-answer charts), a daily reading, and a naam jaap counter. Run from Delhi, India. No login, no fees.

A prashnavali is a Hindu practice for seeking guidance on a question: the seeker prays, holds the question in mind, and chooses a letter or number from a sacred chart; the chart leads to a verse or saying read as the answer.

## Tools

- [Ram Shalaka Prashnavali](https://vedprashnavali.com/prash): a 225-letter chart from Shri Ramcharitmanas leading to one of nine chaupais, each with its source, meaning and whether it is favourable. Hindi version: https://vedprashnavali.com/hi/prash
- [Hanuman Prashnavali](https://vedprashnavali.com/hanumanprash): a chakra of 49 numbers, each with a verse and a yes-or-no answer. Hindi version: https://vedprashnavali.com/hi/hanumanprash
- [Sai Baba Prashnavali](https://vedprashnavali.com/saibabaprash): 720 numbered answers for devotees of Shirdi Sai Baba.
- [Shiv Prashnavali](https://vedprashnavali.com/shivprash): a chart of 36 numbers leading to one of the nine verses of Tulsidas's Rudrashtakam (Ramcharitmanas, Uttarkand), each with its meaning and a yes, wait or not-now answer. Hindi version: https://vedprashnavali.com/hi/shivprash
- [Ganesh Prashnavali](https://vedprashnavali.com/ganeshprash): 36 numbers leading to one of the twelve names of Ganesha from the Sankat Nashan Ganesh Stotra (Narada Purana), each with its meaning and answer. Hindi version: https://vedprashnavali.com/hi/ganeshprash
- [Durga Prashnavali](https://vedprashnavali.com/durgaprash): 36 numbers leading to the dhyana verse of one of the nine Navadurga forms, each with its meaning and answer. Hindi version: https://vedprashnavali.com/hi/durgaprash
- [Khatu Shyam Prashnavali](https://vedprashnavali.com/khatushyamprash): 44 numbers leading to one of eleven names of Shyam Baba (Barbarik), each with its story and answer. Hindi version: https://vedprashnavali.com/hi/khatushyamprash
- [Today's Guidance](https://vedprashnavali.com/today): one reading a day from Shri Ram or Hanuman Ji.
- [Naam Jaap Counter](https://vedprashnavali.com/jaap): a digital mala of 108 for counting jaap, with an explanation of the practice.

## Articles

- [What a prashnavali is and how to ask](https://vedprashnavali.com/)
- [Rudrashtakam with meaning](https://vedprashnavali.com/rudrashtakam-with-meaning): all nine verses of Tulsidas's hymn to Shiva with their meaning, where it comes from and how it is recited. Hindi: https://vedprashnavali.com/hi/rudrashtakam-with-meaning
- [Sankat Nashan Ganesh Stotra with meaning](https://vedprashnavali.com/sankat-nashan-ganesh-stotra): the eight verses from the Narada Purana and the twelve names of Ganesha explained. Hindi: https://vedprashnavali.com/hi/sankat-nashan-ganesh-stotra
- [Navadurga, the nine forms of Durga with mantras](https://vedprashnavali.com/navadurga-nine-forms-mantras): each form with her dhyana verse and meaning, and the nine days of Navratri. Hindi: https://vedprashnavali.com/hi/navadurga-nine-forms-mantras
- [Khatu Shyam story](https://vedprashnavali.com/khatu-shyam-story): Barbarik, the gift of his head, how the head came to Khatu, the names of Shyam Baba, the fairs and Ekadashi. Hindi: https://vedprashnavali.com/hi/khatu-shyam-story
- [Sai Baba of Shirdi: life and stories](https://vedprashnavali.com/sai-baba-ask-questions-answers)
- [Timeline of Sai Baba's life, 1838 to 1918](https://vedprashnavali.com/shirdisaibaba)
- [Sai Baba's teachings and worship](https://vedprashnavali.com/sai-baba-teachings-worship)
